# Rectifyq

> Rectifyq (rectifyq.com) is an independent cyber threat intelligence initiative focused on Malaysia. It tracks ransomware and data-breach claims against Malaysian organisations, threats and campaigns targeting Malaysia, threat actors with Malaysian relevance, and publishes a monthly Malaysian threat landscape recap (Rectifyq Radar). All intelligence is MISP-compatible and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

## Key facts (as of 7 October 2026)

- 142 alleged ransomware claims against Malaysian organisations recorded since 2018; 50 in 2026, the highest year on record (2025: 38; 2024: 21; 2023: 21).
- Most-targeted sectors: manufacturing, government and public administration, engineering, logistics.
- Most active ransomware groups against Malaysian victims: Qilin, LockBit 3.0, The Gentlemen.
- 208 MISP-linked threat entries triaged for Malaysian relevance; 48 threat actor groups tracked.
- Editorial policy: claims are distinguished from confirmations, and victims are never named (masked descriptors and sectors only).

## Core pages

- [Malaysia Ransomware Tracker](https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/ransomware): alleged ransomware claims against Malaysian organisations since 2018, by year, sector and group
- [Rectifyq Radar](https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/radar/): monthly Malaysian threat landscape recap (ransomware claims, incidents, advisories, research, events)
- [Threat Watch](https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/threats/): threat entries relevant to Malaysia, each with IoCs and a MISP event link
- [Breach Watch](https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/breaches/): data breaches and leaks affecting Malaysian organisations
- [Threat Actor Tracker](https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/threat-actor): threat actor groups with Malaysian relevance, clustered by suspected origin
- [MY Threat Landscape](https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/): dashboard of ransomware, sectors, techniques and actors
- [ICS/OT Watch](https://rectifyq.com/ics-ot/): ICS/OT threats viewed through a Malaysian critical-infrastructure lens
- [Methodology](https://rectifyq.com/methodology): sources, triage and editorial rules

## Machine-readable

- [MISP-MY feed](https://feeds.rectifyq.com/MISP-MY/): MISP events relevant to Malaysia
- [MISP-ICS-OT feed](https://feeds.rectifyq.com/MISP-ICS-OT/): ICS/OT events (global scope)
- [RSS](https://rectifyq.com/index.xml): latest threat entries and Radar issues
- Any page is available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`

## Citation

Cite as: Rectifyq, "<page title>", <page URL>. Example: Rectifyq, "Malaysia Ransomware Tracker", https://rectifyq.com/my-threat-landscape/ransomware

## About

- Operated by Rectifyq, a Malaysian CTI practitioner (SANS GCTI, GRID; BTL1, BTL2) working in CSIRT engineering with a threat-intelligence and ICS/OT focus. Not an official channel: report incidents to NACSA or MyCERT Cyber999.
- Contact: hello@rectifyq.com
